cd /workspace/tmp && cat > bench.py <<'EOF'
import random, time
random.seed(1)
for bits in (64, 512, 1700, 4000):
    n = random.getrandbits(bits)
    m = random.getrandbits(bits)
    K=200000
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    acc=[]
    for _ in range(K):
        acc.append(n*m)
    t1=time.perf_counter()
    print(bits, "mul only", round((t1-t0)/K*1e6,3), "us")
    a=n
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(K):
        a = a + m
    t1=time.perf_counter()
    print(bits, "add", round((t1-t0)/K*1e6,3), "us")
EOF
timeout 120 python3 bench.py
